file_roles.evidence: buf_page_io_complete now takes fil_space_acquire_for_io() and holds it through decrypt/corruption check, replacing unreferenced fil_space_get_by_id and FilSpace lookups.
fil_space_acquire(id, true) becomes fil_space_acquire_for_io(id) and the release is renamed; a call-site rename forced by the new API.
Only ut_ad(space->n_pending_ops) becomes ut_ad(space->n_pending_ios > 0) in four asserts.

Adds n_pending_ios, fil_space_acquire_for_io/release_for_io, and a wait 'while (space->n_pending_ios) os_thread_sleep(100)' before freeing; removes the for_io variant that bumped n_pending_ops after stop_new_ops.
FilSpace(space_id, true) replaced by fil_space_acquire_for_io plus release in the error message path; adapts to the removed for_io argument.
Drops the buf_page_check_corrupt declaration and rewrites comments/signatures to match the .cc.
Declares n_pending_ios, the new acquire/release functions and removes the for_io parameter; header side of the fil0fil.cc change.
Same change as innobase buf0buf.cc: acquire_for_io held across decrypt and corruption check in buf_page_io_complete.
fil_space_acquire(bpage->space, true) becomes fil_space_acquire_for_io; same rename as innobase.
Asserts switched from n_pending_ops to n_pending_ios > 0.
fil_space_free becomes fil_space_free_and_mutex_exit and waits 'while (space->n_pending_ios)' after releasing the mutex before freeing the space.
Header declarations and comments updated to match the buf0buf.cc signature changes.
Header side: n_pending_ios field, acquire/release_for_io declarations, removed for_io parameter.

rationale: The assertion space->n_pending_ops == 0 fails because I/O threads can raise the counter after the tablespace is marked for dropping. The fix adds a separate I/O counter, makes free wait on it, and makes the buffer pool I/O paths hold it. Roles for innobase and xtradb copies are assigned the same way.
notes: Judging buf0buf.cc causal but buf0flu.cc as refactor is a close call; buf0buf adds the new lifetime handling, buf0flu only renames the call.
